<!DOCTYPE html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover">
<title>RSL XI FC | Ragdoll Soccer League XI Football Club</title>
<meta name="description" content="RSL XI FC, the Ragdoll Soccer League XI football club: starting lineup and how to join.">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#c4121a">
<link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 32 32'%3E%3Crect width='32' height='32' fill='%23c4121a'/%3E%3Ctext x='16' y='23' font-size='18' font-weight='800' text-anchor='middle' fill='white' font-family='Arial'%3EXI%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"><link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Barlow+Condensed:wght@700;800&family=Barlow:wght@500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{--ink:#14100f;--paper:#efe9dc;--chalk:#f6f2e8;--red:#c4121a;--red-d:#8f0b12;--pitch:#18211b}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:70px}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:500 17px/1.5 Barlow,system-ui,sans-serif;padding:env(safe-area-inset-top) 0 env(safe-area-inset-bottom)}
.d,h1,h2{font-family:"Barlow Condensed","Arial Narrow",sans-serif;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;line-height:.86;letter-spacing:.005em}
a{color:inherit}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1100px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 20px}
header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5;background:var(--paper);border-bottom:3px solid var(--ink)}
header .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;height:62px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;font:800 26px "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.03em}
.brand img{width:40px;height:40px}
nav{margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;font-weight:600}
nav a{text-decoration:none}nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 24px;background:var(--ink);color:var(--chalk);text-decoration:none;font:800 20px "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase}
.btn:hover{background:#000}.btn.r{background:var(--red)}.btn.r:hover{background:var(--red-d)}
nav .btn{min-height:42px;padding:0 18px;font-size:18px}
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--red);color:var(--chalk);border-bottom:8px solid var(--ink)}
.hero .wrap{position:relative;padding-top:34px;padding-bottom:42px}
.kick{font:700 15px Barlow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:14px;max-width:24ch}
h1{font-size:clamp(112px,33vw,340px);line-height:.8;margin-bottom:26px}
h1 i{font-style:normal;color:var(--ink)}
.hero .cr{position:absolute;right:-8vw;top:50%;width:clamp(190px,44vw,460px);transform:translateY(-46%) rotate(9deg);filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 0 rgba(20,16,15,.35))}
.hero .go{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;position:relative}
.hero .go a:not(.btn){font-weight:600;text-underline-offset:5px}
section{padding:56px 0}
h2{font-size:clamp(46px,9vw,84px);margin-bottom:6px}
.sub{font:700 14px Barlow,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--red);margin-bottom:26px}
.xi{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,460px) 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:start}
.pitch{position:relative;aspect-ratio:2/3;background:var(--pitch);border:4px solid var(--ink)}
.pitch i{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);border:2px solid rgba(246,242,232,.55)}
.pitch .pb{top:-2px;width:54%;height:15%;border-top:0}.pitch .pg{bottom:-2px;width:54%;height:15%;border-bottom:0}
.pitch .pl{top:50%;left:0;width:100%;height:0;transform:none;border-width:2px 0 0}
.pitch .pcc{top:50%;width:24%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%)}
.pp{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);width:130px;text-align:center;color:var(--chalk)}
.pp img{display:block;width:54px;height:54px;margin:0 auto;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;border:3px solid var(--chalk)}
.pp em{position:absolute;left:50%;top:42px;transform:translateX(-50%);background:var(--red);font:800 14px/1 "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:3px 8px;font-style:normal}
.pp span{display:block;margin-top:11px;font-weight:600;font-size:13px;line-height:1.2;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.sheet{list-style:none;padding:0;border-top:4px solid var(--ink)}
.sheet li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:92px 60px 1fr;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink)}
.sheet b{font:800 46px/1 "Barlow Condensed",sans-serif;color:var(--red)}
.sheet img{width:60px;height:60px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:50%}
.sheet span{font:700 21px/1.15 Barlow,sans-serif;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.join{background:var(--ink);color:var(--chalk);padding:60px 0}
.join h2{font-size:clamp(54px,12vw,120px);margin-bottom:16px}
.join p{max-width:38ch;margin-bottom:26px}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:var(--chalk);border-top:2px solid rgba(246,242,232,.25);padding:22px 0 30px;font-size:15px}
footer .wrap{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px 28px;align-items:center}
footer a{text-underline-offset:4px}footer span{margin-right:auto}
@media (max-width:860px){
nav a:not(.btn){display:none}
.xi{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:36px}
.pitch{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto;width:100%}
.sheet li{grid-template-columns:78px 54px 1fr;gap:12px}.sheet img{width:54px;height:54px}.sheet b{font-size:40px}
.hero .cr{top:auto;bottom:-6vw;transform:rotate(9deg)}
section{padding:44px 0}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}}
</style></head><body>
<header><div class="wrap"><a class="brand" href="#top"><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="">RSL XI FC</a>
<nav aria-label="Main"><a href="#xi">The XI</a><a href="https://c3llzs.github.io/RSL/">League</a><a href="https://www.roblox.com/games/106931373443671/Ragdoll-Soccer" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Play</a><a class="btn r" href="https://discord.gg/nsQQsNuCT7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Join</a></nav></div></header>
<main id="top">
<div class="hero"><div class="wrap">
<p class="kick">Ragdoll Soccer League XI Football Club</p>
<h1>RSL<br><i>XI</i> FC</h1>
<img class="cr" src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="Ragdoll Soccer League crest">
<div class="go"><a class="btn" href="https://discord.gg/nsQQsNuCT7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Join the Discord</a><a href="https://c3llzs.github.io/RSL/">The league &rarr;</a></div>
</div></div>

</div></div></section>
<div class="join"><div class="wrap"><h2>Join RSL XI FC</h2><p>Trials and team news are in the Discord.</p><a class="btn r" href="https://discord.gg/nsQQsNuCT7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Join the Discord</a></div></div>
</main>
<footer><div class="wrap"><span>RSL XI FC, the club side of the Ragdoll Soccer League</span><a href="https://c3llzs.github.io/RSL/">League</a><a href="https://www.roblox.com/games/106931373443671/Ragdoll-Soccer" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Play Ragdoll Soccer</a><a href="https://discord.gg/nsQQsNuCT7" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Discord</a></div></footer>
</body></html>
